text.tspan: U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve falls to lowest level since 1983 (Copy)
U.S. crude oil stocks held in the Strategic Petroleum Reserve (SPR) have dropped to 316.5 million
barrels in the week of July 10, the lowest level in more than four decades.
